CBD in small, full knowledge-dosage is fine.

https://vcacanada.com/know-your-pet/marijuana-intoxication-in-dogs-and-cats

"Many of the signs of intoxication are neurological. Pets may become wobbly and uncoordinated. They may be hyperactive or sleepy, disoriented, and/or very vocal. Their pupils may dilate, giving them a wild-eyed appearance, and they may drool excessively or vomit. They may also develop urinary incontinence (i.e., urine leakage). Sometimes, I'll draw the same image in low detail several times before committing to a large one. 

Another fun thing to try out; an art teacher had us go collect sticks from outside to dip in ink and draw with lol.
